title: ProxMox: Monitoring - Install host-sflow server
comment: The Host sFlow agent supports Linux performance monitoring, providing a lightweight, scalable solution for monitoring large numbers of Linux servers. The following steps demonstrate how to install and configure the Host sFlow agent on a Linux server, sending sFlow to an analyzer with IP address 10.0.0.50.
